sources.snippet: Bonsai Image 4B is a family of compact text-to-image models designed to run locally on phones, laptops, and NVIDIA GPUs. It is based on FLUX.2 Klein 4B. The diffusion transformer is available with either 1-bit binary or ternary weights.
